name: AI Recipe: Weekly Browser Game
description: Claude designs and builds a complete single-file HTML game in a rotating genre — playable from file://, touch-aware, syntax-checked before it is published — with a design brief and key-art cover.

parameters.help: Claude model alias for the run.

parameters.label: Cover image engine
parameters.help: auto uses the first of GEMINI_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY that is set (add it as a task secret or in the clone's .env). none skips the cover.
